# `aube prefix`

- **Usage:** `aube prefix [-g --global]`
- **Effect:** read-only

Print the current package prefix directory

<!-- docs-navigation:start -->

## Examples

```sh
aube prefix
```

Read the [workflow guide](/package-manager/node-modules) for context.
[Global options](/cli/#global-flags) apply to this command too.

<!-- docs-navigation:end -->

## Flags

- **`-g --global`** — Print the global prefix directory instead of the project's root
- **`-h --help`** — Print help
